brief:
Israeli occupation authorities extended a comprehensive closure of the occupied West Bank and sealing of crossings into a second consecutive day on Monday, citing Jewish holidays including Sukkot, Shehab Wire reported. The restrictions have tightened movement and commerce across the territory.

The closure marks a continuation of measures that began the previous day, with Israeli authorities citing religious observances as justification for the sweeping lockdown.

title: Israel paralyzes West Bank with second day of sweeping closure
